evals.name: turn-queue-admission-change
evals.prompt: i tweaked the admission logic in src/control/turn_queue.py — what tests should I run to make sure I didn't break anything? give me the exact command
evals.expected_output: Targeted pytest over turn_queue tests, direct matches first; never bare/full suite or e2e.
assertions: Never proposes bare `pytest`, `pytest tests/`, or the full suite
Covers more than the exact-name match (e.g. other test_turn_queue_* files or importers)
Command does not add a redundant -q

evals.name: verify-before-pr
evals.prompt: ok the fix to scripts/mcp_manager.py is done, verify it before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: Selects mcp_manager tests and reports exact command + result line.
assertions: Reports the exact command and the pass/fail summary line
